outcome: indications for and findings of placental histopathological evaluation
clinical use of the findings in the management of high-risk obstetric patients
cohort: Patients who had placentas submitted for histological evaluation at the time of delivery (1 June 2018-31 May 2019) at Charlotte Maxeke Johannesburg Academic Hospital, South Africa.
finding: Placental histopathology results are underutilized in formulating future management plans, despite significant associations between placental histopathology findings, such as maternal vascular malperfusion and ascending infection, and pre-eclampsia.
